decisions.reason: Having already been kept once and fitting the firm's core luminaire, planning and dealer capabilities, this ceiling luminaire line is likely to stay unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.
This flexible LED spotlight is very close to the firm's established knowledge base, so management can learn from first-year market feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.
The multi-outlet ceiling canopy complements the firm's modular lighting systems and should be retained because it builds on existing technical and commercial competences.
The low-voltage multi-outlet canopy also fits the firm's system offer, though its more specialised technical niche makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible if demand proves narrow.

These round glass track luminaires match the firm's design-led lighting portfolio, but the weaker website prominence suggests a more tentative commitment and therefore a higher risk of being dropped than the other products.
